name: Axon Enterprise
description: Axon sells TASER stun devices, body and in-car cameras, drones and sensors to police and other public-safety customers, and pairs them with cloud software (evidence storage, records, AI report writing) sold on multi-year subscriptions. The hardware opens the account; the software subscription earns more per dollar, with a 77.5 percent adjusted gross margin versus 51.2 percent on devices. Annual recurring revenue was $1.3 billion at end of 2025. FY2025 revenue grew 33.5 percent to $2.78 billion but the company booked a $62.1 million operating loss on higher headcount and stock compensation.

employees.note: More than 5,100 full-time employees plus more than 1,200 temporary (contractors, interns, consultants); full-time up about 1,000 (24%) in 2025.

businessLines.name: Connected Devices
businessLines.how: One-time hardware sales of TASER devices, cameras, drones and accessories plus extended warranties to agencies, often bundled into multi-year plans with software.

businessLines.name: Software and Services
businessLines.how: Cloud subscriptions (Axon Evidence, Records, Fusus, Draft One AI report writing) billed over multi-year contracts, plus professional services; annual recurring revenue $1.3B.
